name: Hearth-smoked buffalo
summary: Buffalo dried over the hearth, black outside and still red inside, eaten with rice and rượu cần. Order it at Bản Mòng or carry it from the town market. The plate shown is the same dish as served at Tả Phìn Hồ. A price is check on arrival.
origin: The 2020 museum handbook seasons the meat with forest chili, pepper, and mắc khén, and lists it as a gift because it keeps. Bản Mòng’s menus call the same family thịt hun khói.
culture: The handbook lists it as something to carry, because it keeps. At Bản Mòng it sits with the stilt-house meal, beside rice and rượu cần.
texture: The handbook says the meat is black outside and still red inside.
taste: The handbook seasons it with forest chili, pepper, and mắc khén. A further flavor note was not printed.
howToEat: Eat it with rice and rượu cần, at the stilt-house meal, or pack it to carry. A drying time is check on arrival. A stall price is check on arrival.
where: Bản Mòng, xã Hua La, on the edge of the city, and the highland goods at the town market. No stall is a pick. The plate shown is the dish as served at Tả Phìn Hồ. The basket is the same meat at a 2023 culinary festival in Cửa Việt, Quảng Trị.
seoTitle: Hearth-smoked buffalo in Son La — the Ban Mong meal
seoDescription: Buffalo dried over the hearth until the outside is black and the inside is still red, eaten with rice and jar wine at Ban Mong. Check on arrival.
